meta.description: The ArtisBox Play HiFi Speaker hangs on the wall like a painting: 40 W three-way drivers, neodymium magnets, three-channel DSP, just 48 mm deep and four colors.
meta.spec.description: ArtisBox Play HiFi Speaker specifications: 520 × 720 × 48 mm, 4 × 10 W drivers, Bluetooth, 20 V DC, 1.5 A power.
hero.title: Decorative Art Speaker ArtisBox Play Hi-Fi
sec0.item_text:
Three-way speakers
Wide sound, deep bass
sec0.item_text2:
Neodymium magnet drivers
Hear every detail
sec0.item_text5:
Four artful colors
A home with more style
sec0.item_text6:
A unique wall-mounted design
Takes up no space
sec2.title:
95%* acoustic structure
for purer music
sec2.desc: The Hi-Fi grade cabinet, molded in one piece, stops rattles and unwanted resonance, and its large sound chamber gives deep, extended bass. Lift the canvas and it is all sound-making structure: beautiful outside, just as well made inside.
sec3.title:
Three-way speakers
A wide soundstage, powerful bass
sec3.desc: Two 10 W subwoofers, a 10 W midrange and a 10 W tweeter: a 40 W three-way setup where each driver does its own job, for clear, layered sound. Twin L-shaped bass reflex ports keep the bass steady and powerful.
sec4.title:
Neodymium drivers
for every detail
sec4.desc: The drivers use aerospace-grade rare-earth magnets, three times* as sensitive: tighter control of transients and much finer detail bring out the charm of the original sound.
sec4.item_desc: * From ORVIBO lab tests: NdFeB magnets are three times as strong as ordinary ferrite magnets.
sec4.desc2: Three-channel DSP sound processing, with zoned EQ for the cabinet and RDC dynamic range compression, keeps distortion low even at high volume, for rich Hi-Fi sound.
sec5.title: Four artful colors that define a new home aesthetic
sec5.desc: Drawn from the trend for understated luxury art, four chosen colors make a classic more classic.
sec5.info_desc: Bold, free and spirited: a rush of rich passion that holds the eye and fills the room with charm.
sec5.info_desc2: A timeless neutral with grace and strength; poised and seasoned, it knows how to tell a life story.
sec5.info_desc3: Never loud or showy, yet unforgettable: like the backing track in a song, it draws you back.
sec5.info_desc4: A fashionable touch: a bright, cheerful accent in a modern home, bold and playful.
sec6.title: A distinctive art design
sec6.item_subtitle: A new look for background music at home
sec6.desc:
An artistic background speaker for the modern home
An ultra-slim, one-piece body instead of the usual box
The ArtisBox series: a beautiful piece for your home
It blends into any room, any style, and still stands out
sec6.item2_desc: “From the start, our aim was to make ArtisBox a modern work of art to look at, listen to and enjoy.”
sec7.title: A finely crafted piece of home art
sec8.title: Just 48 mm off the wall
sec8.desc: Half the size, none of the sound. Without the bulk of a traditional speaker, it leaves your walls and rooms open and uncluttered.
sec9.title: Mood music for every scene, for total immersion
sec9.desc: Let MixPad put the music on: give every scene its own soundtrack and turn moments at home into little rituals.
sec9.desc2: Surrounded by strings, immersed in old-world charm.
sec9.desc3: Music fills the room, so you lose yourself in your book.
sec9.desc4: One word and it becomes the life of the party.
alt.party: Friends at a party: “Hi Butler, let's party!” “OK, switching to party mode.”
sec10.title: Stronger Bluetooth, smooth playback from afar
sec10.desc: A more professional RF design keeps the connection stable, with a range of up to 15 m.
sec11.title: Two-speaker stereo that feels like being there
sec11.desc: Put two ArtisBox Play (Hi-Fi) speakers in the same room and, once connected, they pair up for full, lifelike stereo sound, like a live music venue, for an even richer listening experience.
sec12.title: Add a floor stand, place it anywhere
sec12.desc: Not just for the wall: with the floor stand, your music takes on new looks.
